user.title: OmaPosti
user.description: Log in to OmaPosti. Authentication happens in your own browser with your bank or Mobiilivarmenne. Posti doesn't allow logging in with a user name and password.

authenticate.title: OmaPosti
authenticate.description:
1. Open [the authentication page]({url}) and authenticate.
2. When the authentication is done, your browser ends up on a page that will most likely show an error. That is the expected result and not a problem. Copy the full address of the page you ended up on from the browser's address bar and paste it here.

Nothing is sent to Home Assistant other than the address you paste. You authenticate only in your own browser, and neither Home Assistant nor this integration has any visibility into the details you enter.

After the login, Home Assistant keeps a device key that keeps you logged in. [What that means for security]({security_url}).

data_description.address: The address your browser ended up on. It should look like {return_address}

data.stale_shipment_day_limit: Days until undelivered packages are hidden

data_description.language: Language of the package event descriptions.
data_description.prioritize_undelivered: When there are more packages than the maximum, undelivered ones are listed before delivered ones.
data_description.max_shipments: How many incoming packages the sensor lists. Set it to 0 to leave incoming packages out altogether, from the counts and events too.
data_description.max_outgoing_shipments: How many sent packages the sensor lists. Set it to 0 to leave sent packages out altogether, from the counts and events too.
data_description.stale_shipment_day_limit: Counted from the package's latest event. Some packages stay in delivery for good.
data_description.completed_shipment_day_shown: Counted from the delivery. Packages returned to the sender count as delivered.
data_description.pickup_code: A code for collecting the package, and if you like a QR code to show at a service point. Off by default as this is sensitive data.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in again as {username}
reauth_confirm.description: Posti does not accept the saved login. Log in again with the same OmaPosti account. In the next steps you authenticate in your own browser with either your bank or Mobiilivarmenne.

error.invalid_auth: Posti didn't accept the authentication. Choose a method and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Posti couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.invalid_address: The address isn't in the right format. After authenticating, copy the full address from the address bar.
error.device_failed: Posti didn't accept Home Assistant as a device, or the login had expired. Log in again.
error.no_account: Posti's login didn't say which account it is. Log in again.
